d: Yavnon ka shasak kshatrap paurash ko dhamkata hai ki unke guptachron ne pahle suchna kyon nahin di ki kuchh brahman aur chhatr, nagrikon ko yavnon ke viruddh khara kar rahe hain. lagta hai kaikay naresh paurash kshatrap ke samne natmastak hai...... pratyek raja ka ye hal na ho bharatvarsh saganthit rahe isi lie vishnugupt dar dar bhatak kar nagrikon va janapdon ko ekatr karne ka kary kar rahe hain ...... kya hoga aage dekhiye is bhag men.
